purpose: Switches between inline peer content panels or navigates peer destinations using a data-driven tab list with optional overflow.

notes: VeliProvider supplies language and direction for the optional overflow menu; English LTR is the fallback.
Pass navigate through VeliProvider when tab items use href for client-side routing.

useWhen: Users switch between related content sections in the same context.
Each tab reveals a panel or navigates to a peer destination via href.
Additional tabs need to be placed in an explicit overflow menu.

avoidWhen.situation: The tabs represent top-level page sections needing the wider page treatment.
The options perform actions rather than reveal content or navigate.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use direct actions or a menu.

supportedInteractions: Link navigation through item href, optional render, and routerOptions
approvedPatterns: Supply at least two items with stable ids and labels.
Include panel content for in-place tabs; omit panel when items navigate with href.
Use size sm, md, or lg to match density; default is sm.
Use leading and trailing slots for icons or badges.
Move explicitly chosen extra tabs into overflowItems.
Wire VeliProvider navigate when any item uses href.
limitations: Overflow is configured by the consumer rather than detected automatically.
Only overflowItems appear in the overflow menu.
keyboardActivation defaults to manual when any item has href.
accessibility: Provide a descriptive listAriaLabel for the tab list when the default Tabs label is insufficient.
React Aria associates each tab with its panel and supplies keyboard behavior.
Disabled tabs are removed from interaction.
responsive: Use overflowItems to keep the visible tab row within constrained widths.
The component does not automatically decide which tabs overflow.
rtl: Overflow menu language and direction follow VeliProvider.
Tab labels and supplied slot content should be appropriate for the active direction.
